feature: V3-05 saved-clip copy, cut for paste and paste through existing immutable revisions
authority: Current ProjectStore/Cue/managed-input/runtime/project CAS; passive ClipReference contains exact original project revision, scene and clip IDs. No new database, queue, renderer, external clipboard, media copy or engine.

added: native Copy retains an exact saved selection without mutation
native Paste preserves original selection and effects at a new scene position
native Cut for Paste retains the removed clip in immutable history
native Paste reuses the cut selection with a fresh stable identity
native Undo restores content after clipboard edits
native Studio failure cleanup closes only the running owned modal
native.cleanup: Owned running modal unwind, real nested-loop control, actual DesktopFrame.Close and retained executor drain; no direct host _closing/Destroy bypass.

guards: Copy and Cut do not open media
Paste reads the exact immutable source revision
No caller-supplied Cue or external path is accepted as copied authority
Current retained input bytes are revalidated
Same-project scenes only; switching project clears UI clipboard
Current revision and fingerprint compare at publication
Cancellation and same-path library replacement retain existing guards
Completed cut/paste retains the ordinary late-stop outcome
limits: Whole saved selections; split/cut interval operations retain their existing separate behavior
No cross-project copy, system clipboard, arbitrary multi-source consolidation or new audio codec/runtime
No new audio-device, acoustic or NVDA qualification
